title: Oven Smoky Greek Lamb Stifado
description: A smoky and energizing Greek dish featuring lamb, pears, and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot. This stifado is anti-inflammatory friendly and offers a unique twist on traditional Greek cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine lamb, smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Heat olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat, then add the lamb mixture and cook until browned on all sides.
Add chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chopped pear to the pot, then pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine pot with a lid, then transfer it to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven, then let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the stifado hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
